verdict.rationale: Docs mention 'Copilot Chat in Outlook and Teams' and Copilot's ability to 'securely interact... using work data (Microsoft Graph and Work IQ)', implying some AI assistant access to Teams content, but there is no explicit documentation of a channel/thread summarization or 'catch-up recap' feature. Missing for 10: explicit docs on channel/thread summary or recap capability, any hands-on or independent confirmation that Copilot actually summarizes missed messages, and details on scope/accuracy of such summaries.
